paper_metadata.title: Falcon2-11B Technical Report
paper_metadata.abstract: We introduce Falcon2-11B, a foundation model trained on over five trillion tokens, and its multimodal counterpart, Falcon2-11B-vlm, which is a vision-to-text model. We report our findings during the training of the Falcon2-11B which follows a multi-stage approach where the early stages are distinguished by their context length and a final stage where we use a curated, high-quality dataset. Additionally, we report the effect of doubling the batch size mid-training and how training loss spikes are affected by the learning rate. The downstream performance of the foundation model is evaluated on established benchmarks, including multilingual and code datasets. The foundation model shows strong generalization across all the tasks which makes it suitable for downstream finetuning use cases. For the vision language model, we report the performance on several benchmarks and show that our model achieves a higher average score compared to open-source models of similar size. The model weights and code of both Falcon2-11B and Falcon2-11B-vlm are made available under a permissive license.

classification.reason: LLM classification: IN_DOMAIN (domain: LLM and VLM release)

extraction_data.innovation: Parallel transformer blocks (MLP and self-attention in parallel with a single layernorm per block); Grouped Query Attention (GQA) with n_kv=8; larger head dimension (128); increased RoPE theta for long context; multi-stage training with context length extension and batch size doubling mid-training.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: RefinedWeb (English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Czech, Romanian, Swedish); curated corpora (code from The Stack, conversations, books, scientific publications, technical reports, encyclopedias, patents)
extraction_data.application: Downstream fine-tuning, multilingual tasks, code datasets
extraction_data.finetuning_data: 1.2M image-text instruction data including multi-round conversations
extraction_data.hardware_description: Stage 1: 4500 GT6 GPUs; Stage 2: 250 GT GPUs; Stage 3: 250 GT GPUs; Stage 4: 500 GT GPUs
extraction_data.extension: Integration of FlashAttention-2 (FA2) to maximize GPU utilization, enabling 128-dimensional attention heads and up to 50% speedup for 8K context windows; multilingual data filtering adapted from English-only heuristics; conversation tree flattening with loss masking.
extraction_data.context_extension_method: RoPE with dynamic theta scaling (θ = RoPE_M + 42, then θ = 500K + 42)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Multi-stage training (4 stages) with context length extension (2048 -> 4096 -> 8192) and a final stage using a curated, high-quality dataset; batch size doubled mid-training
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Concatenation of projected patch embeddings and instruction embeddings along the sequence length
extraction_data.benchmark_result: Better performance on Open LLM Leaderboard compared to Mistral-7B and Llama3-8B, similar to Gemma-7B; surpasses Falcon-40B
